home.eyebrow: Rooted in Montrose, open all four seasons
home.headline: Grow Something Beautiful.
home.intro: Montrose Greenhouse — His & Herbs is a welcoming local florist and seasonal greenhouse in Montrose, Michigan. Stop in for fresh floral arrangements, colorful annuals, herbs, garden plants, hanging baskets, seasonal favorites, and friendly guidance for your home, garden, gifts, and special occasions.

about.headline: A local greenhouse and florist with a four-season heart.
about.intro: Montrose Greenhouse — His & Herbs serves the Montrose area with a mix of floral design, greenhouse plants, herbs, seasonal color, plant gifts, and helpful hometown service.
body: The business brings together two things people love: flowers for meaningful moments and plants that make homes, porches, patios, gardens, and gifts feel alive. Whether someone needs a sympathy arrangement, a cheerful bouquet, spring planting help, fall mums, or a seasonal gift, the shop is designed to feel approachable and useful.

Selections naturally change throughout the year, which is part of what makes a greenhouse fun to visit. Customers can stop by to see what is fresh, call ahead for current availability, or use the contact form to start a floral or plant request.

contactIntro: Have a floral request, plant question, or seasonal order idea? Send the details here and the shop can follow up. For same-day or urgent requests, calling is best.
